# Load packages
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
```

# Define Functions
```{r}
se <- function (x) {sd (x,na.rm =TRUE) / sqrt (length(na.exclude (x)))}

fun_hal <- function (x) {(x - (-286.8851)) / 65.1187}
fun_hol <- function (x) {(x - 284.2803) / 422.3727}
fun_hac <- function (x) {(x - 249.5578) / 839.3971}
```
# 20260622

# wrangle data

```{r}
#dat 10.08.2026
dat_41 <- dat_5[11:205,]

dat_42 <- dat_41 |>
  mutate(area = ifelse(is.na(Area), 0, Area))

dat_43 <- dat_42 |>
  separate(col=Sample, into=c("date", "segment", "iteration"), sep = "_")

dat_43$iteration <- as.numeric(dat_43$iteration)

dat_44 <- dat_43 |>
  mutate(time_min = iteration * 45 - 22 ) # time after wounding (minutes), this is the middle of the iteration bc each chamber took around 15 mins to measure

dat_45 <- dat_44 |>
  mutate(quant = ifelse(Compound == "HAL", fun_hal(area),
                        ifelse(Compound == "HOL", fun_hol(area),
                               ifelse(Compound == "HAC", fun_hac(area), area))))

dat_46 <- dat_45 |>
  mutate(quant = ifelse(area == 0, 0, quant))

dat_10 <- dat_46
```

## Plot

```{r}
# plot combined dat:

pal1 <- c("#8ecae6", "#219ebc", "#126782", "#023047",
          "#ffb703","#fd9e02", "#fb8500")

dat_all <- dat_all |>
  mutate(date = as.factor(date),
         segment = as.factor(segment),
         iteration = as.factor(iteration),
         Compound = as.factor(Compound))

dat_plot <- dat_all |>
  group_by(segment, iteration, Compound) |>
  mutate(mean_a = mean(quant),
         se_a = se(quant))

neworder <- c("HAL","HOL","HAC", "DMNT", "Linalool")
dat_plot1 <- arrange(mutate(dat_plot,
             compound = factor(Compound,levels=neworder)),Compound)

plot5 <- ggplot(dat_plot1, aes(x = time_min, y = mean_a, color = segment)) +
  facet_wrap(~ compound, scales = "free_y") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=mean_a-se_a, ymax= mean_a + se_a), width=0) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.7) + 
  geom_point() +
  scale_color_manual(values = pal1) +
  # scale_x_continuous(limits=c(-5,65), expand = c(0,0), 
  #                    breaks=seq(0,60,15)) +
  scale_fill_manual(labels = c("proximal",
                               "local",
                               "distal"),
                    breaks = c("S1", "S2", "S3")) +
   theme(text = element_text(size=12),
        legend.position = "bottom",
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), 
        panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white",
                                        color = "white"),
        axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"), 
        axis.text = element_text(size=12),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.text.x=element_text(),
        axis.text.y=element_text(color='black'),
        title = element_text(size = 12),
        strip.placement = "outside",
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 12)) +
  labs(x = "time (min)", y = "area")

plot5
```
